description: Contact as it ships: prose, a mailto button addressed from site settings, and a band with no quote column. This is also the page that pins the seam guarantee at app level — the only shipping page that puts something between the prose and the band, so it is where the branching structure would end in mid-air if that content were rendered outside the prose block's foot slot.
